description: action=store: one Shopify store's apps by category (reviews, email, subscriptions, loyalty...), pixels, theme and catalog hints, gaps and sales pitch angles. action=search: stores from our index of ~19k Shopify stores by app used / not used, missing category, country and keyword (lead lists). Price: store $0.02, search $0.05. Store reads are live (3-15 s); the index is refreshed weekly. Paid with x402 (USDC on Base, Polygon or Solana) per call; failed or empty calls are never charged.

action.description: store = one store by domain; search = find stores in the index.

app.description: search: stores using this app, e.g. Klaviyo.

domain.description: store: the store's domain, e.g. allbirds.com.

exclude_app.description: search: stores NOT using this app.

missing.description: search: stores with no app in this category, e.g. loyalty.

q.description: search: keyword in the store name or products.

name: shopify_lookup
title: Shopify store technographics
